info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Inventory Item Update API
info.description: The Product Inventory Item Update API allows businesses to modify existing product inventory details within their system. By utilizing this endpoint, users can efficiently update attributes such as quantity, pricing, and specifications of specific inventory items. This API serves ecommerce platforms and inventory management systems, enabling seamless adjustments to inventory listings. The operation supports typical use cases such as price changes in response to market conditions and stock updates to maintain accurate availability information.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific product inventory item identified by PROD-700045. Ensure that you have the correct inventory item details to successfully perform the update.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the product inventory item with the specified ID. This payload should contain the necessary fields to modify the existing inventory item details.
